property_summary: For any input value x, calling SetMinSum(x) on the correct contract returns normally and updates MinSum to x; the mutant unconditionally reverts so a call to SetMinSum(x) will not succeed for some x (in fact for all x), breaking the rule that SetMinSum succeeds and sets MinSum to the provided value.
change_summary: Make SetMinSum revert unconditionally, preventing any call from changing MinSum.
